verdict.rationale: The open-source Ramp CLI is built for unattended use. It has `--no-input` to disable prompts in CI and `--agent` JSON output for scripting (the default when piped). Standalone agents can authenticate without a browser by exchanging OAuth client credentials (RAMP_CLIENT_ID/SECRET), and `RAMP_PROFILE` pins an identity for automation. This is backed by server-to-server client-credentials API auth, scheduled/background agent access on agents.ramp.com, and a sandbox the CLI connects to by default for safe testing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of CI runs, and a documented CI pipeline example (e.g. a GitHub Actions recipe).
